# Activate Keyboard shortcuts from the profile popover without leaving the dashboard

> Prove that selecting Keyboard shortcuts from the profile popover keeps the user on the same dashboard page.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in the browser and sign in to ORBITAL with {{username}} and {{password}} until the single-page dashboard is visible.

## Step 2

On the loaded ORBITAL dashboard, store the current URL and the currently visible main dashboard view as the baseline for page continuity before Keyboard shortcuts is activated.

## Step 3

In the header-right area, open the avatar containing AP and confirm the profile popover is visible with ABHINAV PANGARIA, Portfolio Manager, Workspace Institutional Demo, Status Active, and the Keyboard shortcuts action.

## Step 4

Activate Keyboard shortcuts from the profile popover.

## Step 5

Assert the browser still shows the same dashboard URL and the same main dashboard view after Keyboard shortcuts is activated.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-146, ac-147, ac-148, ac-149, ac-150, ac-151, ac-153

Confirm state-transition check: same dashboard page remains active after Keyboard shortcuts is activated (equals) — the stated promise: Activating Keyboard shortcuts from the profile popover does not navigate away from the current dashboard page.
